evidence.paraphrase: Every environment-returned frame is retained losslessly with turn and frame indices. inspect and read_pixels revisit original frames, regions, and pixels.

representation_paths.memory_component: durable game understanding and current-level notes

evidence.section: The Complete Pipeline: Reason, then act
evidence.paraphrase: GUIDE.md retains durable revisable game understanding; WORKING.md retains current-level state. Notes, visual memory, and action history survive context restarts.

evidence.section: The Complete Pipeline: Reason, then act
evidence.paraphrase: The same reusable prompt asks the agent to update its compact game model when new evidence changes what is supported; the notes change, without evidence that the memory-management policy itself is persistently revised.

derived.hybrid_relation: Original visual evidence and revisable explicit notes are separately addressable and jointly used for subsequent reasoning and action.

adjudication_notes: Classification verified against the official project method; no new global recoding of the corpus was performed.
Primary image modality reflects the PNG observation interface; interactive gameplay does not by itself establish a GUI-memory architecture.
Revision of notes changes memory state under stable instructions, supporting T2 rather than T3.
